sum: Centerra Gold Inc. engages in the operation, development, exploration, and acquisition of gold and copper properties in North America, Turkey, and internationally. The company also owns and operates a molybdenum business unit, which includes a metallurgical processing facility and two primary molybdenum properties. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
ceo: Mr. Paul Botond Stilicho Tomory (President, CEO & Director)
